habit_scope: AF&PA Building or Sheathing Paper: Type 15 asphalt-saturated felt (or other water-repellent paper/film, perm ≥5) over wall sheathing, bottom-up. 1–2 story wood-frame. Not housewrap brand. Not a window-flashing Method.
how_it_is_done: Walls are already sheathed (P08). Cover the wall sheathing with Type 15 asphalt-saturated felt paper or other suitable water-repellent paper or plastic films (AF&PA Building or Sheathing Paper).
The covering must permit moisture vapor that enters the wall from the interior to pass. Vapor permeability rating of five or greater. This is not the interior 4-mil poly vapor retarder (that is P13).
Six-inch wide strips of sheathing paper around all wall openings and behind all exterior trim (AF&PA Figs 54 and 55).
Apply from the bottom of the wall. Lap horizontal joints 4 inches. Lap vertical joints 6 inches. Do not invent other laps. Do not invent pan flashings or end-dams — they are not in this book.
Store window and door assemblies, siding, and exterior trim off the weather until they go on (AF&PA Protection of materials). That is storage, not a window-unit install sequence.
can_overlap_notes: Paper goes on before siding (AF&PA: siding applied over Type 15 felt). Window-unit install is still a Gap — do not invent a pan/end-dam overlap.
trades: AF&PA: job foreman, subcontractors, building inspector — no crew size
tools_equipment: Not a tool list in sources.
inspection_hold_points: Type 15 felt or equal water-repellent covering with vapor permeability of five or greater (AF&PA Building or Sheathing Paper).
Applied from the bottom of the wall; horizontal joints lapped 4 in; vertical joints lapped 6 in.
6-in wide strips of sheathing paper around all wall openings and behind all exterior trim (Figs 54 and 55).
when_this_beats_habit: This is the AF&PA habit covering under siding. Not a housewrap-brand winner. Window flashing is not this method.
when_this_is_a_bad_idea: Using this paper as the interior vapor retarder (wrong side; perm 5+ is the opposite of the 4-mil poly in P13). Inventing pan flashings or end-dams from this chapter. Skipping the 6-in strips at openings.
why_tier1_never_learned_it: They paper the wall. What they skip is bottom-up 4 in / 6 in laps and 6-in strips at openings as printed.
permit_gate: not named as a permit-gate type swap in this chapter
permit_gate_notes: WRB product is not a foundation-type permit gate in AF&PA. Window/door flashing still Gap.
risk_if_swapped_late: Siding is applied over the paper (AF&PA Exterior Siding). Paper after siding is a tear-off, not a save. Book did not name dollars.
plain_language_summary: On the 2-story stick house, after the walls are sheathed, cover them with Type 15 felt (or equal that still breathes — perm 5 or more). Start at the bottom. Overlap 4 inches on the horizontal joints and 6 inches on the vertical. Six-inch strips around windows and doors and behind exterior trim. That is all this book prints. Do not invent pans or end-dams from it.
spanish_summary: En la casa de palo de 2 pisos, después del forro, cubra con fieltro Tipo 15 (o igual que respire — perm 5 o más). De abajo hacia arriba. Traslape 4 pulgadas en juntas horizontales y 6 en verticales. Tiras de 6 pulgadas alrededor de huecos y detrás del trim. El libro no imprime tapajuntas de alféizar ni end-dams — no los invente.

walkthroughs.what_it_shows: Field house 15-lb felt over sheathing. Laps, 6-in strips, and 2-story not spoken. Book still AF&PA 4 in horiz / 6 in vert. Do not invent IRC. Hunt cw-P10-2026-08-30.

walkthroughs.title: Tyvek house wrap with 60 minute jumbo Tex  paper.
walkthroughs.what_it_shows: Named Grade D two-layer, bottom-up, 3 in horiz, tucked under window flashing. Book is AF&PA 4 in horiz / 6 in vert — keep both, confirm AHJ. Tyvek in that clip is extra, not habit. Jumbo Tex is Grade D building paper CLASS. Do not flip paper habit to housewrap. Hunt cw-P10-2026-08-30.
